facts.business: Sky Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of innovative fastening and narrow woven fabric solutions, specializing in Hook & Loop fastening systems, Elastic & Woven Tapes, Webbings, Neoprene products, and other specialized textile solutions for sectors including Footwear, Healthcare, Automotive, Defence, Sportswear, Orthopaedics, Packaging, Personal Protective Equipment, and Apparel.

capacity_or_capex.item: New state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Gujarat

key_risks: Raw material price volatility, supply disruption or quality issues in key raw materials such as nylon, polyester & synthetics
Need for continuous technological upgrades to remain competitive
